name: android_scan_media_file
description: Triggers Android MediaStore to scan and index a newly pushed or modified audio/video file so media apps immediately discover it.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the media file on device (e.g., /sdcard/Music/song.mp3).
